steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Configure the metadata inside app-meta.json including dynamic app name 'Creative Canvas' and package name 'com.creativecanvas.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Create the root and app-level Gradle build files targeting SDK 34, utilizing Gradle 8.5, and setting AGP to 8.3.2 with strict Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with correct package namespace, launcher configurations, and support for Material Light themes.

steps.title: Design App Interface Layout
steps.description: Create a multi-screen user interface structure in activity_main.xml featuring custom views, dynamic sliding puzzle grid, filter canvas, and custom toolbar views.

steps.title: Implement Main Navigation Framework
steps.description: Develop core screen-switching mechanisms in MainActivity.java to swap dynamically between Dashboard, Studio, and Puzzle views.

steps.title: Integrate Native Assets
steps.description: Verify referencing of user-provided drawables asset_6a9f18319c82d and asset_6a9f1839db93c for visual preview and play canvas.

steps.title: Implement Art Filter Studio Logic
steps.description: Write fast-rendering color matrix adjustment logic in MainActivity.java for Grayscale, Sepia, Negative, and Sunlight effects.

steps.title: Implement Text overlay Controller
steps.description: Build high-resolution dynamic text layers overlaying the selected canvas images with custom scale and interactive color controls.

steps.title: Build Image Slicing Logic for Puzzle
steps.description: Develop a dynamic runtime bitmap slicer that takes the chosen image asset and divides it into a clean 3x3 matrix block of puzzle tiles.

steps.title: Develop 3x3 Sliding Board Mechanics
steps.description: Write game state engine to shuffle boards via solvable simulated movements, detect neighbor cell coordinates, and handle interactive slides.

steps.title: Implement Win Condition Detection
steps.description: Create game state verification loops in MainActivity to count moves, track match positions, and display celebration popups.

steps.title: Add UI Styling and Polish
steps.description: Refine interface borders, modern buttons, custom backgrounds, responsive card selectors, and dynamic text previews.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Code Standards
steps.description: Perform safety checks on MainActivity.java to guarantee that no modern Lambdas, Streams, or method references are used.

steps.title: Building Creative Canvas
steps.description: Compile, build and pack the entire package assets into a fully validated Android Debug APK.
